description: TokenEconomizer on the GitHub Copilot CLI: inject learned repo facts at session start, guard prompt-turns against failing loops, and fold each finished session into what is learned.

hooks.windows: & { $env:PYTHONUTF8 = '1'; $OutputEncoding = [Console]::InputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding; $payload = if ($MyInvocation.ExpectingInput) { $input -join "`n" } else { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; $hook = Join-Path $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts\te-hook.cmd'; $payload | & $hook --host copilot; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
